goal: Audit a repo along independent dimensions at once, then synthesise
label: audit

tasks.prompt: Audit this repo for security issues: injection, authz gaps, secrets in source, unsafe deserialisation. file:line findings only.
Audit this repo for performance problems: N+1 queries, unbounded loads, sync I/O on hot paths. file:line findings only.
Identify the highest-risk untested code paths in this repo. Rank by blast radius. file:line only.
Using only the three audit results above, write a single prioritised markdown report. Group by severity, drop duplicates, and note where two audits flag the same root cause. Do not re-read the repo.
